description.value:
Cost: Provided with the Operating System
Slots: 12

Cyberdeck with 4 slots for Hardware and 8 for Programs. Using it for an Overheat or Synapse Burnout Quickhack lets the user try a single DV8 or lower Quickhack on the same target with no Net Action, rolled separately; if either check fails, both fail.

Foundry notes:

  • The sheet has one slot count, so this carries all 12; it won't keep Hardware and Programs to their own 4 and 8.
  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
